hero.sub: A silent-luxury equestrian atelier. Leather goods, saddles and home born from the craft. Buenos Aires · present in 30+ countries.
manifesto.p1: Horse Brand is born from the equestrian world and the elegance that surrounds it.
manifesto.p2: Inspired by the horse, equestrian sport and the art of the saddle, the brand interprets a legacy where tradition, discipline and sophistication coexist naturally.
manifesto.quote: Luxury that doesn't shout. It whispers.
manifesto.caption: — Equestrian saddle · Archive piece
origen.p1: At the origin: a workshop, hand-tanned leather, and a horse. A saddle brand that began dressing competition horses and never stopped.
origen.p2: Four decades later the craft remains intact. Every piece is born from the same vocation — to serve the horse. Everything else (the bag, the armchair, the table) came after, as a natural extension of the same gaze.
origen.quote: The horse leads. The craft follows.
origen.caption: — Show jumping
caballo.lead_1: Symbol of nobility, discipline and freedom —
caballo.lead_2: defines our identity and our vision of luxury: authentic, silent and profoundly tied to artisanal excellence.
caballo.closer: Everything gathers around a singular being.
polo.sub: The equestrian world inspires every detail.
polo.p: Polo, jumping, dressage. Apparel and saddles built for elite competition, with the same precision each discipline demands. The brand was born on the field and returns to it in every piece.
universe.sub: Atelier, stables, table, home and sport. Everything meets in the same language.
universe.atelier_text: The craft of leather. The saddle as origin.
universe.stables_text: Where silence fills with the sound of horses.
universe.restaurant_text: Premium stable. Table of those who live it.
universe.home_text: The countryside enters the living room. Wood, leather, character.
universe.equestrian_text: For the horse and the rider. Competition-grade gear.
collection.sub: A curated selection of our most iconic silhouettes.
split.p: A universe where leather breathes, sunlight filters through trees, and each piece finds its place between the everyday and the extraordinary.
craft.p: Each piece undergoes more than forty hand operations. Cutting, beveling, edge dyeing, stitch by stitch. Time is not our enemy: it is our material.
craft.stat_1_caption: Time is the true material of every honest craft.
craft.stat_2_caption: Every piece of leather remembers the hands that shaped it.
craft.stat_3_caption: Nobility cannot be imitated: it is cured with time.
heritage.intro: Ten own bases. More than twenty markets with representation. The same craft in every leather.
contact.p: Private atelier · Visits by appointment · Bespoke orders.
